name: ui-click
prompt: Single short soft wooden button click, dry and muted, no reverb, user interface press sound

name: input-tick
prompt: Quick light mechanical tick, like a pen tap on a wooden desk, crisp and very short

name: invalid-buzz
prompt: Short low dull error buzz, soft rubbery denied-action sound, muted and not harsh

name: trail-step
prompt: Single soft footstep on packed dirt trail, short quiet scuff, dry outdoor recording

name: trail-step-alt
prompt: Single soft footstep on short grass, gentle muted scuff, slightly lighter than a dirt step

name: claim-burst
prompt: Cloth flag unfurling snap followed by a small bright rising chime, triumphant land-claim flourish

name: trail-cut
prompt: Sharp snip of scissors cutting a taut string, quick slicing snap with a tiny twang

name: eliminated-thud
prompt: Heavy soft body falling onto earth, low dull thud with a short dusty settle, game elimination

name: warning-ping
prompt: Single urgent metallic warning ping, small struck triangle with fast decay, alert but quiet

name: win-fanfare
prompt: Small brass fanfare flourish, three bright rising notes ending on a warm held chord, victory jingle

name: lose-fall
prompt: Short descending slide whistle ending in a soft sad thump, gentle comic defeat sound

name: countdown-beep
prompt: Single clean electronic countdown beep, round sine tone with short smooth decay
